## What changed

Describe the concrete trigger and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the commands or checks that can detect a meaningful failure.

- [ ] Existing tests pass.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a regression test.
- [ ] Ruff, Bandit, dependency audit, build, and coverage checks pass.

## Security effect

Describe changes to input handling, dependencies, data exposure, authentication, authorization, cryptography, or external interfaces. Write `None` when none apply.

## Data and license impact

State whether the change adds or alters data, provenance, source links, or license scope. Write `None` when it does not.
